name: mirage
text: Understood, and agreed: profit = winnings paid back on bets and bids with a final result minus what those same bets and bids cost. No wallet, deposits or withdrawals anywhere, and anything without a final result (open bets, later days, games not yet final) is left out of every total and graph, so it can never read as a loss. Days work the same way per slate, and Today updates as results come in. The daily part already worked like this; I've now changed the all-time card to the same rule and the tests pass. It's committed and goes out in the next release (I'll batch it with anything else you send); I'll send the link when it's out.
